Definition: Ai, Aja or Ajath, a place in Palestine
BiblicalUsage: Ai was the city beside Bethel where Abram pitched his tent, and the city where Israel first failed after Jericho: Joshua sent men to spy it out, the first attack was beaten back because of Achan's sin, and then God told Joshua to take the city without fear. Isaiah later names Ai on the road of the Assyrian's advance toward Jerusalem.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Ai teaches me both sides of the same truth: a small city can defeat a whole army when sin is hidden in the camp, and no defeat is final when God says to rise and take it.
RelatedEvents: The Defeat at Ai and Achan's Sin
